title: Binary product coefficient equality
statement: For a natural number $\ell$, let $m,a,b\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$. The Boolean test returns true exactly when, for every integer $d$ with $0\le d\le 2\ell$, the degree-$d$ binary convolution coefficient of $a$ and $b$ equals the degree-$d$ monic coefficient specified by $m$.
